BiblicalUsage: Othniel was the first judge of Israel. He took Kirjath-sepher and won Caleb's daughter Achsah, and when Israel cried to the Lord, the Spirit of the Lord came upon him and he judged Israel and went out to war.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Othniel is the proof that God raises deliverers from the family itself: Caleb's younger brother took the city and then judged Israel for forty years.
